omnidisksweeper.reason: Homebrew’s official cask associates this identifier’s cache and preferences with OmniDiskSweeper.app, while the other candidate is explicitly the Omni software-update service.

omnigraffle.reason: The official cask associates this identifier’s application scripts and container with OmniGraffle.app; the other candidate is explicitly an iCloud container identifier.

omnioutliner.reason: Homebrew installs OmniOutliner.app; the matching identifier is the main application container, while the .Thumbnails identifier belongs to its thumbnail extension.

onyx.reason: The identifier is used for OnyX preferences and saved application state; com.titanium.OnyX.help is its Help Book identifier.

opal-composer.reason: This identifier owns Composer's caches, HTTP storage, and preferences. The 97Z3HJWCRT-prefixed value is an Apple team-scoped group-container identifier.

opencat.reason: This identifier owns OpenCat's application container, caches, preferences, and saved state; group.tech.baye.openai is a group container and the .revenuecat identifier belongs to its purchasing integration.

openchamber.reason: OpenChamber's official Electron package manifest directly declares dev.openchamber.desktop as build.appId; ai.opencode.openchamber is retained in legacy application-support and preference paths.

openclaw.reason: The official distribution script explicitly sets this as the release bundle ID and verifies that the packaged app’s CFBundleIdentifier matches it.

openin.reason: The vendor’s documentation identifies this as the app container; the other candidate is explicitly the JavaScript executor helper.

openinterminal.reason: The official Xcode project assigns this identifier to the OpenInTerminal application target and assigns the other candidates to its Finder extension, helper, or app group.

openlogi.reason: The official repository’s bundle-identity table labels this as the production OpenLogi app; the other identifiers belong to the agent and overlay helpers.

opera-air.reason: Apple’s official browser manifest names this as Opera Air’s macOS bundle and code-signing identifier; the Installer-prefixed candidate belongs to the installer.

opera-gx.reason: Homebrew installs Opera GX.app and associates com.operasoftware.OperaGX with its preferences and saved application state; the only alternative is explicitly the Opera GX installer.

opera@developer.reason: An Opera forum crash report directly records com.operasoftware.OperaDeveloper as Opera Developer's CFBundleIdentifier; Homebrew's other candidate is explicitly the installer.

pagico.reason: Homebrew associates com.pagico.mac with Pagico's preferences, cache, saved state, and WebKit data. The vendor identifies the other candidate as Pagico's bundled Safari browser extension.

paletro.reason: Homebrew installs Paletro.app and associates io.appmakes.Paletro with its preferences and application data; the other candidate is explicitly PaletroLaunchHelper.

papers.reason: Homebrew associates com.ReadCube.Papers with the Papers app's preferences, cache, recent documents, and saved state; the other candidate is explicitly the installer. ReadCube's deployment documentation separately distinguishes Papers.app from its macOS installer.

parallels.reason: Official Homebrew metadata targets Parallels Desktop.app and uses this identifier for its termination signal; Parallels’ official forum crash reports also map that app’s prl_client_app executable to this identifier.

parallels@18.reason: An official Parallels forum crash report for Parallels Desktop 18 directly identifies /Applications/Parallels Desktop.app/Contents/MacOS/prl_client_app with this identifier.

parallels@19.reason: Official Parallels forum crash reports for Parallels Desktop 19 directly map the main executable inside Parallels Desktop.app to this identifier.

parallels@20.reason: Official Homebrew metadata targets Parallels Desktop.app and signals this identifier; an official Parallels forum crash report for version 20 directly maps the main app executable to it.

pcoipclient.reason: Official Homebrew metadata installs PCoIPClient.app and lists this identifier plus com.teradici.usb-mediator for quitting; HP’s official documentation identifies usb-mediator as the app’s USB component, leaving com.teradici.swiftclient as the primary app identifier.

pdf-squeezer.reason: The vendor identifies this as PDF Squeezer’s application container; the other candidate is explicitly an app-group identifier.

pikpak.reason: The cask associates this identifier with PikPak’s preferences, caches, HTTP storage, and recent-document state; the other candidate belongs to the embedded PikPlayer component.

pinwheel.reason: The cask associates this identifier with Pinwheel’s preferences, HTTP storage, and saved application state; the other identifier names the PinwheelPreviewer extension.

plaud.reason: The cask associates this identifier with Plaud’s main preferences and recent-document state, while the other candidate explicitly identifies an Electron renderer helper.

pock.reason: Pock’s official project separates the main Pock application from QLPockWidget; the cask likewise assigns preferences, caches, and application support to this identifier while the other candidate names the Quick Look widget.

pocket-casts.reason: Homebrew installs the current Electron-based Pocket Casts.app; its metadata consistently uses com.electron.pocket-casts, while au.com.shiftyjelly.PocketCasts is residue from the older native app.

pokerstars.reason: PokerStars identifies PokerStars.app as the main macOS program and lists PokerStarsBrowse.app and Update.app separately; Homebrew maps their identifiers accordingly.

postgres-app.reason: The official Xcode project assigns com.postgresapp.Postgres2 to the Postgres target that produces Postgres.app; Postgres2MenuHelper belongs to the separate helper target.

power-manager.reason: Homebrew installs Power Manager.app, and the candidate ending in .standard corresponds to its main application container; .update.download is the updater component. The vendor also documents restoring the Mac application bundle identifier.

printopia.reason: The vendor's official update manifest identifies the downloadable Printopia application with app_id com.decisivetactics.printopia; the -server identifier belongs to its background server.

provideoplayer.reason: The official Homebrew cask installs ProVideoPlayer.app; its app-specific preferences, caches, HTTP storage, and recent-document records use com.renewedvision.pvp. The other candidate is explicitly a Bugsnag shared-data identifier.

provisionql.reason: The vendor's official repository separates the ProvisionQL application from its preview and thumbnail extension targets; the unsuffixed identifier belongs to the primary ProvisionQL.app target.

qspace-pro.reason: The official Homebrew cask installs QSpace Pro.app. Its preferences, saved application state, caches, and WebKit data use the base identifier; the only alternative is explicitly the StashShelfShareExtension.

quicklook-video.reason: The vendor's Xcode project directly assigns uk.org.marginal.qlvideo to the QuickLook Video application target and assigns the candidate suffixed identifiers to embedded media extensions.

quip.reason: The official cask installs Quip.app and records its preferences, caches, application support, and WebKit data under com.quip.Desktop; the other identifier is explicitly the embedded Quick Look Preview extension.

raindropio.reason: The official Raindrop.io desktop repository's build configuration directly declares this value as the appId for the packaged desktop application.

rambox.reason: Rambox's official Community Edition packaging manifest directly declares this appId; com.saenzramiro.rambox is retained legacy data.

raze.reason: The current app is maintained under the official ZDoom organization, while Homebrew retains both this identifier and the older org.drdteam.raze identifier for cleanup. No current Info.plist was available for direct confirmation.

readyapi.reason: Homebrew records both install4j identifiers as quit targets, and the official SmartBear material does not establish which one belongs to the installed ReadyAPI app rather than another launcher or architecture-specific artifact.

reamp.reason: Homebrew's official cask metadata associates this identifier's preferences, caches, HTTP storage, and application support with the main reAMP app; the other candidate explicitly names the bundled Quick Look extension.

receipts.reason: The cask associates the base identifier with Receipts.app data; the other candidate is explicitly its share extension.

roboform.reason: The current cask associates this identifier with RoboForm’s application support, caches, HTTP storage, preferences, and WebKit data. The uppercase identifier appears to be retained for an older app generation, while the remaining candidates are services or extensions.

rowmote-helper.reason: The base identifier owns Rowmote Helper’s preferences, caches, and HTTP storage; the other candidate is explicitly the app’s sandboxed Helper component.

sage.reason: The official distribution supplies SageMath as the primary macOS app, and the cask’s installer package identifiers use the org.computop.SageMath namespace. The other identifiers correspond to the Sage runtime or bundled Tcl/Tk components.

scapple.reason: The cask associates this identifier with Scapple’s preferences, caches, HTTP storage, autosave data, and recent documents; the other candidate is explicitly an iCloud container identifier.

screenkite.reason: Homebrew installs ScreenKite.app; the unsuffixed identifier owns its preferences and saved state, while the other candidates are explicitly Preview and Thumbnail extensions.

scrolla.reason: The identifier is associated with Scrolla's preferences and saved application state; the only alternative is explicitly its launch-at-login helper.

sensei.reason: The identifier owns Sensei's preferences and saved application state; the other candidate is explicitly the separate SenseiMonitor process.

sessionwatcher.reason: Homebrew installs SessionWatcher.app, and this identifier owns its preferences and WebKit data; the alternatives are widget/writer extensions or group identifiers.

setapp.reason: Homebrew installs Setapp.app; this identifier owns its preferences and saved application state, while the alternatives identify SetappAgent and its Finder Sync extension.

shottr.reason: The vendor uses cc.ffitch.shottr as Shottr's settings domain; the other candidate explicitly belongs to its launch-at-login helper.

silentknight.reason: Homebrew installs SilentKnight3.app, and the vendor identifies SilentKnight 3 as the current application. This distinguishes the version-3 identifier from the legacy SilentKnight identifier, though no official manifest was available.

skint.reason: The vendor identifies Skint as the regular primary app and SkintM as its separate menu-bar variant, and explicitly documents co.eclecticlight.Skint.plist for Skint.

smultron.reason: The vendor directly uses com.peterborgapps.Smultron14 for Smultron 14 settings and identifies HT76L9L9RG.com.peterborgapps.Smultron as a group container.

sofa-server.reason: Homebrew identifies Sofa Server.app as the installed application; org.tordini.flavio.SofaHelper explicitly names a helper, leaving org.tordini.flavio.sofa-server as the main-app identifier. No official manifest exposing CFBundleIdentifier was available.

soulver.reason: The alternative identifier is explicitly the Quick Look/Spotlight extension; app.soulver.mac is the main Soulver 3 application identifier used for its preferences, caches, and saved state.

spacelauncher.reason: The vendor’s changelog identifies name.guoc.SpaceLauncher as SpaceLauncher’s application-support namespace; the other candidate is a Bugsnag shared-data identifier.

sparkplate.reason: The official release is the Electron-based Sparkplate.app, and com.sparkplate.app has the corresponding application saved-state and preference records. The io.greenfire namespace also includes a helper identifier and appears to be an older identity, but no accessible official manifest directly confirms the release bundle.

ssdreporter-free.reason: CoreCode’s official documentation uses com.corecode.SSDReporter as the defaults domain for SSDReporter; the alternative explicitly names its launch helper.

stremio.reason: The current cask installs Stremio 5 from the official stremio-shell-macos distribution and records its WebKit/cache data under com.stremio.stremio-shell-macos; com.smartcodeltd.stremio is retained only for legacy preferences and saved state.

stremio@beta.reason: The cask installs the current Stremio 5 beta and its cleanup metadata associates that build with this cache/WebKit identifier. com.smartcodeltd.stremio is the legacy Stremio identifier, but no directly inspectable official app manifest was available.

suspicious-package.reason: The vendor's official download metadata explicitly reports this bundle identifier. The other candidate belongs to its Quick Look preview extension.

swift-publisher.reason: The vendor's removal guide associates Swift Publisher 5.app with this preferences/container identifier. The alternatives are explicitly a group container and a thumbnail extension.

swiftbar.reason: The official repository consistently uses this domain for SwiftBar's preferences and metadata; the other candidate explicitly identifies the launch-at-login helper.

swiftplantumlapp.reason: The official Xcode project assigns this PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER to the SwiftPlantUMLApp target. The other candidate explicitly belongs to its source-editor extension.

swinsian.reason: The main app's preference domain is com.swinsian.Swinsian; the other candidates are explicitly named artwork and chapter reader components.

syntax-highlight.reason: The official Xcode project assigns this identifier to Syntax Highlight.app; the alternatives are its app group, Quick Look extension, and shortcut command.

sysex-librarian.reason: The official application project identifies SysEx Librarian with this bundle ID; com.snoize.SnoizeMIDI belongs to the supporting MIDI framework.

texifier.reason: The cask installs the vendor's direct-download Texifier.app, whose persistent app-specific cache, preferences, saved state, and WebKit data all use the legacy Texpad identifier; the other candidate is an iCloud container. The vendor documents separate website and App Store builds, so this is channel-specific rather than a direct manifest confirmation.

tg-pro.reason: This identifier owns TG Pro's preferences and caches, while the vendor explicitly describes TGFanHelper as TG Pro's privileged helper app.

ths.reason: The official cask associates this identifier with the main app container; the only alternative is explicitly the widget identifier.

ticktick.reason: The official cask uses this exact identifier for TickTick's preferences, caches, saved state, and application support. The other candidates are a team-prefixed group container and a Bugsnag shared domain.

timemator.reason: The official cask associates this identifier with Timemator's preferences, caches, and application support; the alternatives are explicitly a widget extension and an app-group identifier.

toolreleases.reason: The vendor's official repository identifies ToolReleases as the packaged app, and the official cask uses this identifier for its app-specific preferences and caches. The other candidate is Apple's System Events process.

topnotch.reason: The official cask associates this identifier with TopNotch's preferences, caches, HTTP storage, and WebKit data; the alternative is explicitly its LaunchAtLoginHelper.

trex.reason: The official Xcode project assigns this identifier to the TRex application target; the alternative explicitly belongs to its launch-at-login helper.

trickster.reason: The Homebrew cask installs Trickster.app; this candidate identifies Trickster itself, while the other explicitly identifies TricksterLauncher.

tripmode.reason: TripMode's official release notes use this domain for the application's preferences; the other candidate is a team-prefixed app-group container identifier.

tyme.reason: Tyme's official documentation identifies this as the macOS application's container and Application Scripts domain; the alternative explicitly belongs to its menu-bar helper.

unite.reason: The cask installs Unite 6.6, and its version-scoped com.BZG.unite.* application data distinguishes the primary Unite 6 identity from the shared app-group identifier.

updf.reason: UPDF.app uses the matching application-support, cache, preferences, WebKit, and saved-state domain; the other candidate explicitly belongs to UPDF Installer.

viber.reason: Viber.app uses this domain across application support, caches, HTTP storage, preferences, and saved state. The macvibershare candidate is a sandboxed sharing extension.

vox.reason: VOX.app uses this domain for its main container, application support, preferences, and saved state; VOXAgent and Vox-Helper are auxiliary components.

webex.reason: The cask installs Webex.app and terminates Cisco-Systems.Spark during uninstall, while Cisco's official macOS documentation identifies Cisco-Systems.Spark as the Webex app's domain. The listed candidates instead represent the legacy meeting manager and an application group.

webtorrent.reason: WebTorrent.app consistently uses this domain for caches, cookies, HTTP storage, preferences, WebKit data, and saved state; the .ShipIt candidate belongs to its updater.

whatcable.reason: The developer's official release notes identify uk.whatcable.whatcable as the current app bundle ID and com.bitmoor.whatcable as the retired pre-0.6.0 ID.

whatsapp@beta.reason: Homebrew installs WhatsApp.app; the other candidates are explicitly Sparkle updater and progress services, leaving net.whatsapp.WhatsApp as the primary app identifier.

wins.reason: Homebrew installs Wins.app and records cool.wins.WinsHelper separately as its launch service; the main app's caches, preferences, and saved-item records use cools.wins.main.

wondershare-filmora.reason: The cask's primary artifact is Wondershare Filmora Mac.app; com.wondershare.Installer is explicitly installer-related, while Filmora's application state and caches use com.wondershare.filmoramac.

wondershare-uniconverter.reason: The identifier directly matches the installed Wondershare UniConverter 17.app and its support data; com.google.Chrome belongs to a separate or embedded Chrome component.

wpsoffice-cn.reason: The cask installs wpsoffice.app; this base identifier corresponds to its main sandbox container, while the other candidates are explicitly FinderSync, Finder-menu, and recent-files components.

yingfu-online.reason: The cask installs 英孚乐学.app and records this identifier's preferences and caches; the only alternative ends in ShipIt, identifying the app's updater component.

yinxiangbiji.reason: The cask installs 印象笔记.app and associates this identifier with its primary preferences, caches, and application-support data; com.yinxiang.MacHelper is explicitly a helper process.

yoink.reason: The cask installs the vendor's downloadable trial of Yoink.app. This candidate is the trial application's identifier, whereas G78RJ6NLJU.group.at.EternalStorms.Yoink is an application-group identifier.

yousician.reason: The cask artifact is specifically Yousician Launcher.app, and its saved-state and cache paths use this identifier; unity.Yousician.Yousician belongs to the separately launched Unity application.

zight.reason: Homebrew’s cask associates Zight.app with this application-support, cache, and preference domain while separately identifying the .Share extension and launch helper.

zulip.reason: Zulip’s official desktop build manifest directly declares this appId for the Zulip application.
